description:
This video explains how information becomes geometry in holographic theories, specifically through the Ryu-Takayanagi formula and its interpretation in kinematic space.

Report sources:
https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0603001
https://arxiv.org/abs/0705.0016
https://arxiv.org/abs/1505.05515
thumbnailPrompt: A 16:9 illustration of a point in kinematic space representing an extended interval on a boundary and its corresponding bulk geodesic, with a subtle background texture suggesting the connection between information and geometry.
title: From Information to Geometry: Kinematic Space and Holography
